algorithm.Title: Hip Pain - Male (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Male
Definition: UAT-only adult and pediatric non-traumatic hip-pain pathway screening for septic arthritis, systemic illness and inability to stand or bear weight before in-person assessment.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for a hot painful joint with systemic illness, inability to stand or bear weight, severe rapidly worsening pain, or a seriously unwell child. Do not allow self-driving or force walking. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Did this problem begin with a motor vehicle crash or as part of a multi-system crash injury?
questions.Information: A motor vehicle crash or multi-system crash injury belongs in the Motor Vehicle Accident pathway.

questions.Question: Is hip pain severe with inability to stand or bear weight, or accompanied by marked systemic illness, confusion, breathing change, collapse or rapid deterioration, including a seriously unwell child?
questions.Information: NHS.UK joint pain guidance identifies these as reasons for urgent clinical review; the local Qatar urgent-care pathway is used here.

questions.Question: With no emergency feature, is there any persistent or unexplained hip pain, limp/functional limitation, pregnancy/postpartum state, night pain, child concern or higher-risk context?
questions.Information: In-person assessment is required; every child joint problem needs clinical review and telephone triage cannot exclude serious hip pathology.

advice.Title: Qatar emergency hip response
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for a hot painful joint with systemic illness, inability to stand or bear weight, severe rapidly worsening pain, or a seriously unwell child. Do not allow self-driving or force walking. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: fever/systemic illness; cannot walk or bear weight.

advice.Title: In-person hip assessment
Content: Arrange in-person assessment. Any child hip/joint problem, pregnancy/postpartum pain, night pain, functional loss or unexplained persistent pain requires an age-appropriate pathway. Medication and exact Qatar destination are local approval required.
Call Back If: pain worsens; walking difficulty; swelling, redness or fever.

references: NHS.UK, "Joint pain", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/joint-pain/ (page last reviewed 26 February 2026) - applied to non-traumatic hip pain
